name: Oronok’s account of Gul’dan

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Oronok tells how Gul’dan spoke the Cipher’s words, shattered Draenor, and severed the orcs from their elemental ties. This is a memory carried by Oronok’s quest account, not an omniscient transcript of every event on the old world. Its consequence is present around him: spirits strain against the valley’s corruption, and three fragments must be found before the words can be confronted whole.
